miniaudio 0.11.25, vendored from https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio/tree/0.11.25.

`miniaudio.h` is the unmodified upstream header. `miniaudio.c` compiles its
implementation once for the application. See `LICENSE` for the upstream public
domain / MIT-0 licensing options. Audio backends are loaded at runtime; MP3
decoding is included, so no external player or codec installation is needed.
